name: example-agency-restaurant
title: restaurant page kind
description: A static restaurant or food-business page kind: hero with a reservation call to action, menu highlights with nullable prices, hours and location with a nullable address and phone, a reservations step, chef or story, a photography gallery placeholder, optional diner reviews and a footer. Fits a restaurant, cafe, bar or bakery. Composed from eleven vendored HyperUI blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the restaurant family for a static restaurant, cafe, bar or bakery mock: a hero with a reservation call to action, menu highlights, hours and location, a reservations step, chef or story, a photography gallery placeholder and optional diner reviews. Ask for the business, its cuisine and where it is, generate a schemaVersion 2 restaurant typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder.
